card.name: Small words before day-part timing
card.fires_on: Small linking words or brackets such as for, over, at, busy right before a phrase about the day, meals or dose intervals. The next words are likely to be the day, three meals or hours.

modes.label: Spreading intake across the day
modes.description: The word over or for just before three meals or the day.
modes.example: Distribute the daily intake of fat, carbohydrate, and protein<< over>> three main meals.

modes.label: Dose spacing after first dose
modes.description: The bracket or at after additional doses (1 or 2), leading into intervals of hours.
modes.example: Give first dose on awakening; additional doses (1 or 2)<< at>> intervals of 4 to 6 hours

modes.label: Everyday day-part phrases
modes.description: A word in general web text just before a day-related noun like day or work day.
modes.example: setting up your metabolism properly<< for>> the day.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with words for the day or day parts, such as day, daily, morning and afternoon, including Chinese ones.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come right before a phrase like 'the day' or 'three meals' or 'every few hours'.
